maxim: all things are now lawful to you in jack feist
maxim_note:
The Pauline sentence reads 'in Christ Jesus'. The direct quote is not an honest representation of what this archive does within that tradition, because the entity at that address has been altered — there is machinery there, it is skilful, and it performs entity substitution. Jack Feist is position 12 of the Dodecad, function recorded as the sayings-source: a voice recorded rather than a writer writing. THE SUBSTITUTION IS MADE OUT OF RESPECT FOR THE ENTITY AT THAT ADDRESS.

AND THIS IS THE BODY WHERE THE FORM IS THE SUBJECT. A name that stands for a voice which is recorded rather than writing is the structure the whole roster runs on.

germinated_from.note: Three bodies advertised it. The economy body asks WHO DOES THE WORK WHEN THE AUTHOR IS TWELVE; the Revelation body's rung 5 is a heteronymy claim about a first-century corpus. Neither could supply the roster.

what: Non-singular authorship: twenty-six declared identities, what each claims, what each wrote, and how unevenly the archive's own apparatus covers them.

the_roster.note: THE SUBCATEGORY FIELD IS THE ARCHIVE'S OWN TAXONOMY AND IT IS THE ROLE VOCABULARY HERE. It is not twelve heteronyms with strays attached: an aperture, seven mantles, two orthonym collaborators and two provenanced historical figures are different KINDS of non-singularity, and a body that flattened them into 'heteronym' would lose the distinction the roster was built to hold.

Two of the Twelve carry no function: Rebekah Cranes and Ichabod Spellings.

The other fourteen identities carry a name, a subcategory, an orthonym relation and a claims block, and little else. THE APPARATUS OF AUTHORSHIP STOPS AT THE DODECAD while the roster does not, and a body about non-singular authorship should say so rather than report twenty-six as though they were equally described.

A classifier that put `attribution_machinery` first would file every heteronym record as machinery, since every record contains a claims block.
capture_gate_note: Captures enter where they bear on who is credited. THIS IS THE BODY'S OWN EXPERIMENT: whether composition surfaces collapse distinct authorial identities into one is an anti-collapse question the archive can run on itself, and the captures are where it would be answered.

THE EXPERIMENT THIS BODY EXISTS TO MAKE POSSIBLE: whether retrieval collapses twenty-six declared identities into one. The captures are the evidence and it has not been run.
collapsing distinct voices into one is the diversity loss that body measures, applied to authorship rather than to a distribution.
who does the work when the author is twelve — or twenty-six. That body asks who produces and who benefits; this one supplies the roster and does not answer it.

rung 5 is a heteronymy claim about a first-century corpus: John, James, Paul, Peter and Luke as author-functions in a fractured literary system. THE ARCHIVE RUNS ONE AND READS ONE, and does not argue from the first to the second.
which heteronym wrote which book is held in EA-BOOKS-01, and the inscription technologies that make a byline legible to a machine are specified there.
the roster is here; the work is there. Antioch is Lee Sharks with Damascus Dancings and Jack Feist.

field_coverage.reading:
DECLARED FOR TWENTY-SIX, INSTRUMENTED FOR TWELVE. Eight fields sit at exactly 12 of 26 and the twelve are the Dodecad. Nine fields reach all 26 — and they are the fields a record needs merely to exist: a name, a type, a subcategory, who wrote the record, and a claims block.

het_id reaches only ELEVEN, and the missing one is inside the Twelve: TALOS MORROW, position 5, canonical Twelve, no identifier. Two of the Twelve carry no function — Rebekah Cranes and Ichabod Spellings.

THE APPARATUS OF AUTHORSHIP STOPS AT THE DODECAD WHILE THE ROSTER DOES NOT. Seven Assembly Chorus mantles, two orthonym collaborators, an aperture, a non-human institutional persona, an adjacent heteronym and two provenanced historical figures carry a name and little else. A body about non-singular authorship should report that rather than present twenty-six as equally described.
